stories.title: Query Size Estimation Contract
stories.description: Define a standard contract for estimating Mongo query size including parameters (document_count, avg_doc_size, projected_response_size) and thresholds aligned with GPTReader limits (100-doc cap, 500KB response cap).

stories.title: Core Query Size Estimation Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to estimate Mongo query result size prior to execution using document count limits, sampling or heuristics, and enforce guardrails to prevent oversized queries.

stories.title: Pre-Execution Query Guard Integration
stories.description: Integrate size estimation into GPTReader query execution path to block or truncate queries that exceed size thresholds, returning safe error or partial responses.

stories.title: Query Size Estimation Tests
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating size estimation accuracy, enforcement of 100-document and 500KB limits, and correct handling of oversized query scenarios.

stories.title: Audit Logging for Query Size Enforcement
stories.description: Implement logging of estimated query sizes, blocked queries, and truncation events including metadata (query type, estimated size, outcome) for observability and debugging.
